Gideon, in this channel your first report of the kiosks being offline on 3 Aug was at **10:42 AM** ("gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant", both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan).

From 10:42 to the 11:03 kiosk 1 recovery, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard, per your 10:42 post. Mateo then reported at 11:03 that the guard had checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. Kiosk 2 was kept powered on for Carrowmere's reconnect attempts, and you posted at 11:08 that both lanes were working.

This covers only #inc-vtg-hartford. If the postmortem needs an earlier report elsewhere, that would have to be checked in those channels.
